models.closure: Freeze completed living P,Q,diet,predation,accumulation,migration. Solve EE for SM; detritus accumulation absorbs routed inflow at fixed predation. No new consumption is assumed.
models.group_identity_source: UTF-8 frozen JSON group_seq/group_name; immutable numeric sequence.

metadata.author: Vasconcellos, M.
metadata.reference: Vasconcellos M.,Watson R.(2004). Mass-balance models of oceanic systems in the Atlantic West African marine ecosystems: models and fisheries impacts. pp 171-214. In Palomares M.L.D.,Pauly D.

models.native_time_unit: not explicitly recorded in this JSON metadata; no annual reconstruction or cross-model absolute aggregation
models.native_area_unit: not explicitly recorded by currency enum

physical.balance_tolerance: 1e-4 group-relative living/consumption and whole; 1e-7 absolute detritus; original rounding residuals preserved

warnings: 2 group(s) have near-zero TE (0 < EE << 1): 4 (Seabirds), 3 (Beaked whales). Their SPPR is near-singular (inherent to the TE method); the detritus SPPR may be inflated and is not corrected by fix_EE_0_cases.

limitations: Numerical eligibility does not establish ecological truth or global representativeness.
Existing JSON metadata establishes natural detritus fate; no fleet discard-return destination was extracted.
Detritus export is excluded from fishery H by the unchanged loader; detritus accumulation remains the dependent residual.
Native currency WetWeight; missing area/time normalization stays unknown.
Detritus zero-row to identity changes are bookkeeping only; nonzero overwritten source fates and unsupplied baseline stock draw are excluded.
Time models from the same named ecosystem are dependent observations, not independent ecosystems.
models.baseline_validation: Existing saved workbook plus fresh unmodified frozen-calculator/zero-discard equality and independent analytic/conservation checks. Saved differences are explicitly retained; see normalization replay provenance.

uncertainty_type: discard-routing sensitivity envelope; not a confidence interval
evaluation: same frozen native living harvest H at every fraction; retained L=(1-f)H evaluated separately
native_carbon_conversion: Native wet-weight PP equivalents divided by 9, same assumed conversion as atlas; ratio uses identical conversion in numerator and denominator

source_rule: Destination evidence and hypothetical designated amount are separate. Numerical closure does not establish ecological truth.
